validate_training_manifest: run the voxcpm cli validate command to check a JSONL training manifest for errors and missing audio files
validate_manifest_function: call validate_manifest to validate a JSONL manifest file and get a ValidationResult with errors and warnings
check_audio_file: use _check_audio_file to verify an audio file exists and matches the expected sample rate
validation_result_is_valid: check the ValidationResult is_valid property to determine if the manifest passed all validation checks
print_validation_report: call print_validation_report to display a formatted summary of validation errors, warnings, and statistics to stderr
